title: Proud Fart
blurb: Announced rather than released. This one opens at full volume, takes a breath halfway through and pushes on to a second peak, which is the acoustic equivalent of making eye contact while it happens. There is no apology anywhere in the waveform. A steady, brassy midrange gives it the bearing of a short trumpet voluntary, and the two-stage delivery makes it feel rehearsed. Use it for triumphs played completely straight: a promotion email, a difficult parallel park, a boss kill. No other button on this hub would take a bow, and this one is already bowing.
origin: A generic fart recording with a notably assertive two-stage delivery.
